name: Crusader Quotes for WooCommerce
author: devherodigital

sections.description:
Crusader Quotes for WooCommerce is a quoting plugin designed for products that cannot be priced upfront.

Instead of forcing customers to choose incorrect pricing, you can enable a Request Quote option on selected products. Customers submit their product options, and you receive the request directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

From there, you can assign one or more prices, generate purchasable WooCommerce products, and send checkout links to the customer.

This plugin is ideal for:
* Print shops
* Sign shops
* Custom manufacturers
* Wholesale or bulk pricing workflows
* Any WooCommerce store that needs manual pricing approval

Crusader Quotes for WooCommerce is free forever.
Optional Pro add-ons introduce automation and advanced product management tools.

Features

  • Replace Add to Cart with Request Quote on selected WooCommerce products
  • Configure custom quote fields per product using a dedicated Product Data tab
  • Capture customer selections and quantities
  • Display quote requests inside the WordPress admin
  • Assign one or multiple price options per quote
  • Generate WooCommerce products directly from quotes
  • Send customers direct product links for checkout
  • Paginated admin quote list with submission dates
  • Clean, WooCommerce-native workflow (no shortcodes or forms)

How It Works

  1. Enable quote mode on selected WooCommerce products
  2. Define custom quote fields inside the product editor
  3. Customer submits a quote request from the product page
  4. Admin reviews the quote inside WordPress
  5. Admin sets pricing and generates quote products
  6. Customer receives product links and completes checkout
sections.installation:
Upload the crusader-quotes folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
4. Enable quote mode and configure fields on supported products
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required.

Does this plugin replace the cart system?

No. It replaces Add to Cart only for products you choose. Generated quote products use standard WooCommerce checkout.

Can I offer multiple price options?

Yes. You can generate multiple quote products from a single request.

Does the plugin send emails automatically?

The free version generates product links for easy copy/paste into your email responses. Automation features are planned for Pro add-ons.

Will quote products clutter my WooCommerce catalog?

Quote products are created under a hidden category by default.
